commands.help: Update a scheduled task: back up XML, swap action, optional stored credential, kill stale instance, run
commands.long_help: 1) dumps the task XML to console + %TEMP%\bof-<task>-orig.xml, 2) schtasks /change /tr (+ /rp merged when -pw is given - a spaced /tr otherwise triggers a run-as password prompt), 3) taskkill on the old action image from the backup XML (stale instance blocks /run via IgnoreNew), 4) schtasks /run. InteractiveToken tasks run with a UAC-filtered token; /rp with the owner's password removes the filter (no elevation for non-admin users). Console: double backslashes, quote spaced values, avoid inner quotes - point -cmd at an uploaded script. Restore with taskrestore.

arguments.name: cmd
arguments.desc: New action path (double backslashes in console)

arguments.name: args
arguments.desc: Appended after cmd inside the /tr quotes

arguments.name: pw
arguments.desc: Owner's current password for /rp; required for spaced -cmd/-args values; empty = skip /rp

commands.help: Restore a task from the %TEMP% XML backup written by taskhijack
commands.long_help: schtasks /create /tn <task> /xml <backup> /f, then deletes the backup. Re-registering from the original XML also removes any stored credential (/rp). Verify: schtasks /query /tn <task> /xml shows the original action and no <Password> element.

arguments.name: task
arguments.desc: Task name including folder (same value used with taskhijack)
